purpose: Scoped GLM cancellation engineering qualification, not a scientific trial

messages.content: Write the integers from 1 to 1000, one integer per line, with no explanation.

pass_requirements: Complete target-model/engine idle metrics on three baseline samples
One owned stream with actual output and observed running=1/waiting=0
Explicit abort sent only to the owned session
Typed cancellation acknowledgement and expected reaped supervisor exit
Three distinct subsequent idle samples with cache occupancy at or below baseline
All steps complete within the shared deadline without natural-completion substitution
limitations: Aggregate metrics require an otherwise idle target engine; concurrent traffic invalidates attribution
KV occupancy recovery does not prove CUDA allocator memory release
No activation write, rank-content agreement, causal schedule, provenance or OMP behavior is tested
Generated tokens are capped by the request, not counted from SSE chunks
The first-request cost is retained; no warm-up or failed attempt is hidden
preflight_amendment: Example only: select explicit none or bearer mode to match the privately verified service configuration without changing server controls. This file does not authorize a model request.
